observer: Append synchronized read-only snapshots after a full training iteration and before evaluation at20/200 for flops and20/60 for river. Kernel and training/evaluation/graph code unchanged. Snapshots contain all actual action/chance/owner/lock metadata and both complete physical reach images.
observed_subsets: Actor0 own reach consumed during p1 down; actor1 own reach consumed during p0 down and retained because p1 uses down_nh1=0 in root/action/chance. Every input row has a unique physical owner writer; all sources and actual metadata are checked. p0 actor0 is not observed.
limitations: No pre-normalization regret-sum finiteness measurement, all-iteration frequency, production time share, device-only cost or speed claim. Unchanged benchmark records/checkpoints must match the exact anchor. Diagnostic snapshots include I/O and are never performance qualification.
